title: Pensioners present at the Democratic Party’s draft-budget protest outside Parliament
reason: Reported gathering occurred outside the assigned month (November 19, 2024), not January 2025.
notes: BalkanWeb says pensioners were present with pension-increase banners at a Democratic Party protest against the 2025 draft budget. It gives no assembled attendance count and does not establish pensioner-only turnout. A separate pensioner gathering outside the Prime Minister’s Office is described only as occurring “a few days ago”; its exact date, attendance and relation to this episode remain unknown and it is not assigned to January.
